infoModal.title: How It Works
infoModal.step1Desc: Select a lane or leave it on All Lanes, then click Spin to get a random champion.
infoModal.step2Desc: Jump into a match with your assigned champion and give it your best shot.
infoModal.step2ProTip: Pro tip: You can play without logging in, but you won't be able to track your progress.
infoModal.step3Win: If you won: +100 XP, build your streak, unlock achievements
infoModal.step3Lose: If you lost: Streak resets, but you can try again!
infoModal.step4Desc: Earn XP, level up, unlock achievements, and climb the global leaderboard.
infoModal.faqFreeA: Yes! League Roulette is completely free to use. No hidden fees or premium subscriptions.
infoModal.faqLoginA: No, you can generate random champions without logging in. Login is only required to track wins, earn XP, and use the leaderboard.
infoModal.faqPasswordA: Yes. We use Riot's official OAuth — your password is never stored on our servers. With manual login, we only verify your public Riot ID.
infoModal.faqModesA: Any matchmade game mode counts: Summoner's Rift (all queues), ARAM, and rotating game modes.

about.title: About League Roulette
about.subtitle: Challenging League of Legends players since 2024
about.missionP1: League Roulette was created to add a fresh layer of excitement to League of Legends. We believe that stepping outside your comfort zone is the best way to improve and have fun.
about.missionP2: Our platform randomly assigns champions, pushing players to master new roles, discover hidden favorites, and break free from autopilot mode.
about.storyP1: Born from the simple question: 'What champion should I play?' League Roulette started as a small side project to solve that daily dilemma.
about.storyP2: What began as a basic randomizer grew into a full-featured challenge platform with win tracking, achievements, XP, and a global leaderboard.
about.storyP3: Today, thousands of players use League Roulette to spice up their games, learn new champions, and compete with friends.
about.offerRandomDesc: Instant random champion picks filtered by lane. Unbiased and truly random.
about.offerVerifyDesc: Automatic match verification using Riot Games API. Play your game, we'll handle the rest.
about.offerXpDesc: Earn XP, level up, and unlock achievements as you complete challenges.
about.offerLeaderboardDesc: Compete with players worldwide. Climb the ranks and prove your versatility.
about.offerStreaksDesc: Build and maintain win streaks. How many random champion wins can you chain?
about.whyP1: Playing random champions is one of the best ways to improve at League of Legends. It breaks you out of your comfort zone and forces you to learn.
whyBullets: Discover new champions you might never have tried
Learn multiple roles and become a flexible player
Understand champion matchups from both sides
Keep the game fresh and exciting
Build game knowledge that makes you a better player overall
about.communityP1: League Roulette is more than a tool — it's a community of players who love League of Legends and enjoy taking on new challenges.
about.communityP2: Follow us on social media, join our Discord, and share your random champion experiences with fellow summoners.
about.communityP3: Have suggestions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you. Visit our {contactLink}.
about.valueFairPlayDesc: Every champion selection is truly random. No bias, no patterns — just pure RNG.
about.valuePrivacyDesc: We never store passwords. Riot OAuth keeps your account secure. Your data is yours.
about.valueInnovationDesc: We're always improving with new features, achievements, and challenges based on your feedback.
